name: Pear Desktop Scaffold Validation
description: Verify that scaffolded Pear Desktop projects install, have valid JS, and the app launches without crashing

measure.name: package-json-valid
measure.command: node -e "import { readFileSync } from 'fs'; const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync('./package.json','utf-8')); if (!p.name || p.main !== 'electron/main.js' || !p.upgrade) throw new Error('missing Electron/Pear OTA config fields')"

measure.name: pear-deps-present
measure.command: node -e "import { readFileSync } from 'fs'; const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync('./package.json','utf-8')); const d = p.dependencies; if (!d['pear-runtime'] || !p.devDependencies?.electron) throw new Error('missing pear-runtime/electron')"

measure.name: required-files-exist
measure.command: test -f index.html && test -f electron/main.js && test -f electron/preload.cjs && test -f worker.js && test -f app/bridge.js && test -f app/index.js
